items.description: Generate, test, and iterate on new reusable agent skills directly inside their Claude or Cursor workflow.
items.summary: Skill Creator is Anthropic's workflow for drafting new agent skills and improving existing ones through eval loops. It starts by capturing intent, trigger phrases, output formats, and whether objective test cases make sense. Authors write SKILL.md with progressive disclosure: metadata, body under 500 lines, and bundled scripts, references, and assets loaded on demand. The eval workflow spawns with-skill and baseline runs in parallel, drafts assertions while runs execute, grades outputs, aggregates benchmark.json, and launches eval-viewer/generate_review.py for human review before rewriting. Improvement guidance stresses generalizing from feedback, keeping prompts lean, explaining why behind rules, and bundling repeated helper scripts. An advanced description optimization loop generates should-trigger and should-not-trigger queries, runs scripts/run_loop, and updates frontmatter descriptions for better invocation accuracy. The skill adapts for Claude.ai, Cowork, and packaging via scripts/package_skill when available. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, run evals, benchmark variance, or optimize triggering descriptions.
highlights: End-to-end loop: capture intent, draft SKILL.md, run evals, review in generate_review.py, iterate until satisfied.
Parallel with-skill and baseline subagent runs with timing.json capture and assertion grading via agents/grader.md.
Progressive disclosure pattern: metadata, SKILL.md body, and on-demand scripts, references, and assets.
Description optimization via 20-query trigger eval sets and scripts/run_loop for frontmatter tuning.
Platform adaptations documented for Claude.ai, Cowork static viewers, and package_skill distribution.

items.name: azure-cost
items.author: microsoft
items.description: Query historical Azure spending, forecast future bills, and identify cost-saving opportunities across their deployed resources.
items.summary: Azure Cost is a unified Microsoft agent skill for querying historical Azure spend, forecasting future bills, and finding optimization opportunities. It routes user intent to three workflows: cost query for breakdowns by service, resource, location, or tag; cost optimization for orphaned resources, rightsizing, and waste reduction; and cost forecast for end-of-month projections. It uses the Cost Management REST API via az rest with api-version 2023-11-01, prefers MCP tools like azure__documentation and azure__extension_cli_generate over raw CLI guessing, and requires Cost Management Reader plus Monitoring Reader roles. Guardrails mandate presenting actual queried data labeled ACTUAL DATA, validating pricing from official sources, including Azure Portal links, and never executing destructive deletes without explicit approval. Optimization workflows must show the total bill alongside savings recommendations, and sub-ten-dollar monthly costs should emphasize operational improvements over financial savings. Rate-limit handling requires honoring x-ms-ratelimit retry-after headers. Do not use for deploying resources, security audits, or estimating costs for not-yet-deployed resources.
highlights: Unified routing across cost query, cost optimization, and cost forecast workflows with shared scope reference.
Uses Cost Management REST API via az rest with ClientType GitHubCopilotForAzure header requirement.
Prefers MCP tools azure__documentation, azure__extension_cli_generate, and azure__get_azure_bestpractices.
Safety rules: no destructive deletes without approval, dry-run commands, and bill shown with optimization advice.
Data classification labels: ACTUAL DATA, ACTUAL METRICS, VALIDATED PRICING, and ESTIMATED SAVINGS.
